what: The size on the drive of the Mac's own 4-bit copy (its pack) of three models: the files of <store>/<model>-<revision>/, read with stat. Nothing was run, trained or written.
machine: Mac mini M4, 10 GPU cores, 16 GB
store: <mac>/hf (the store the round 4 runs read: "store" in their preferences.toml)
command: for each pack folder d: /usr/bin/find "$d" -type f -exec /usr/bin/stat -f "%z %N" {} + ; /usr/bin/du -sk "$d"
counted: every file in the pack folder: model.sss (one NF4 slab per decoder layer, and the input and output embeddings in bf16), model.sss.idx (its index) and small.safetensors (the rest of the text backbone, bf16)
whole_of_what_training_reads: Of the weights, yes: a run on this Mac reads the model's weights from these three files only (poros/metal/pack.py). It also reads the model's config.json and tokenizer files from the Hub cache, which are not counted here.
same_pack_as_round4: The round 4 table rows read these folders: one folder per model in the store, each index written before the rows ran (2026-11-17 20:12 to 2026-11-18 00:06 local time), and the rows' job did not pack again (its pack step returns when the index is there; no pack line in by-head/5d75e31a/results.jsonl). The receipts do not record the pack's size or revision.
